sample_data.reset_instructions: Run `npm run db:seed` or execute `db/seed.sql` to restore the 64-student initial cohort with all edge cases.

problem_solving_method: Built a pure, fully deterministic grading engine (lib/grading.ts) where every calculation step attaches an explicit rule reference ID (R-10, R-11, R-12, R-13, R-29). Marks are the sole source of truth stored in PostgreSQL, and all grade points, GPAs, letter grades, and checking lists are computed on demand.

R1.evidence: db/schema.sql, db/seed.sql, scripts/seed.mjs — 64 students across 2 classes (Science & Business Studies), 6 compulsory & 1 optional subject, theory/practical mark splits, and 10 hand-written edge cases.

R2.evidence: lib/grading.ts — evaluateSubject and evaluateStudent functions compute grade points, final GPA, uncancelled GPA, and letter grades according to rule tables.

R3.evidence: app/(app)/students/[id]/page.tsx — detailed per-student calculation trace showing marks used, subject grade points, bonus calculations, and rule citations for every decision.

R4.evidence: app/(app)/checking-lists/page.tsx — dedicated office checking lists categorizing students with optional subject issues, practical fails, or absences.

team_members.major_contribution: Full-stack development of Next.js GPA Engine application, pure grading engine logic, database schema, seed scripts, rule verification suite, and UI implementation.
Frontend design, page layouts, components styling, and verification.

major_design_decisions: Pure computational grading engine: Marks are stored as the single source of truth; GPAs, grades, and checking lists are calculated dynamically on every request to prevent stale results.
Rule-cited evaluation trace: Every calculation step outputs rule IDs (R-10, R-11, R-12, R-13, R-29) so every grade result can be audited directly back to its underlying rule.
known_limitations: Subject mark tables assume standard 100-mark scale breakdown (80+ A+, 70-79 A, 60-69 A-, 50-59 B, 40-49 C, 33-39 D, <33 F).
